retrieved.title: SSO access failing for s.joshi to AWS
retrieved.description: [TCK-31764] Ticket raised because user s.joshi cannot reach the AWS application through single sign-on and is bounced back to the login screen. This is impacting daily work.
retrieved.resolution: Found s.joshi was missing from the AWS SSO assignment group; added them to the group and confirmed federated login to AWS succeeded.

retrieved.title: Login broken on Ticketing System
retrieved.description: [TCK-78583] Monitoring alerted us that no user can log in to Ticketing System; the login page accepts credentials then redirects back to itself. Escalating for investigation.
retrieved.resolution: The Ticketing System session cookie domain was misconfigured after a deploy; corrected the cookie settings and cleared the CDN cache to fix login.

retrieved.title: Login broken on Billing Portal
retrieved.description: [TCK-18561] Ticket raised because no user can log in to Billing Portal; the login page accepts credentials then redirects back to itself. This is impacting daily work.
retrieved.resolution: The Billing Portal session cookie domain was misconfigured after a deploy; corrected the cookie settings and cleared the CDN cache to fix login.

retrieved.title: MFA reset request for v.nair
retrieved.description: [TCK-65306] Ticket raised because user v.nair lost their phone and cannot complete multi-factor authentication to sign in. This is impacting daily work.
retrieved.resolution: Verified v.nair out of band, reset their MFA enrolment, and guided them through registering a new authenticator device.
